name: Ichibanboshi Hideo
source:
He has recently started playing online games. He's your typical game novice.

He is interested in Kohane his classmate. She is the girl of his dreams.

Hhe is usually easy-going and mild-mannered, but he also shows his manly side at any moment. However, there are many times where his passion spins out of control.

Occupation: High school student
Comprehension Skills: "mediocre", "one who lives reciprocal life with school and home".
Three sizes: Do you really want to hear? / Actually bust 90 cm
Nickname Online: tetuONE
